chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Ablution is half of the Faith.

key_terms.الْإِيمَانُ: Faith, belief in God and the divine message
key_terms.الْوُضُوءُ: Ritual ablution, the minor purification performed before prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Wudu in relation to Iman according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this famous hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) equates ritual ablution (wudu) with half of faith, emphasizing its status as a fundamental pillar of spiritual and physical purity. This statement underscores the Shia scholarly view that wudu is not merely a preparatory act but an intrinsic component of iman, serving as the gateway to valid prayer and divine connection.
